title: And His Name Is John Cena
blurb: AND HIS NAME IS JOHN CENA — the trumpet fanfare plus that legendary announcement, meme-ified into the universal sound of a surprise entrance. It plays when anyone or anything arrives unexpectedly and with maximum force: the pizza guy, the plot twist, your mom when the lights were supposed to be off. One of the defining prank sounds of an entire internet era.
origin: John Cena's WWE entrance announcement, immortalized by the unexpected-Cena prank meme.
